newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean soldier holds three hostages-TV.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean soldier holds three hostages-TV.

text.p: A South Korean soldier on Wednesday seized two women and a man hostage in a travel agency in the east coast city of Kangnung, state television reported.
Korean Broadcasting System (KBS) television said the soldier had been under police escort on a charge of desertion when he escaped and entered the agency.
Police in the city could not immediately be reached.
The soldier, identified only by his family name Chung, was wielding what KBS said was believed to be a knife.
The two women were identified as workers at the office and the man was a customer who was in the office when Chung entered, KBS said.
Police surrounded the office, it said. It was not immediately clear what Chung was demanding and no more details were immediately available.
Kangnung is about 170 km (106 miles) east of the capital Seoul.
